messages:
Chris: Quick sync — we just provisioned AWS sandbox acct 12345 for the new listing but the trial SKU/entitlements aren't showing up in the publisher portal. Anyone seen this before?
Priya: on it. rough first pass: role mapping didn't propagate from our onboarding lambda, getting a 403 from the /entitlements call.
Priya: error from logs: `AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::12345:assumed-role/OnboardLambdaRole is not authorized to perform: marketplace:ListEntitlements`
Mike P: that suggests the MarketplacePublisherRole policy didn't get attached. Could be a timing/order issue in our onboarding job. I can patch the orchestration to retry on 403.
Chris: thanks. is this why publisher UI shows account but no SKUs?
Priya: yes, if ListEntitlements fails we return an empty set to the UI. will try a manual assume-role to verify permissions.
Priya: manual test snippet:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::12345:role/MarketplacePublisherRole --role-session-name test
aws marketplace-entitlement --profile assumed list-entitlements --product-code "redwood-rl2"
```
Mike P: noted. I'll add a quick retry + backoff in the onboarding worker and a small monitoring check that fails the job if role attach didn't converge in 10m.
Anika: legal flag — while this is being resolved, remember we need EULA locale mapping in the listing metadata. For EU accounts we must include the localized terms URL. If SKUs appear before EULA prop is set, ops may have to delist temporarily.
Laura: thanks Anika. Can you paste the final EULA URLs? I'll add to the product packaging manifest.
Anika: putting them here: https://redwood.com/legal/eula-en, https://redwood.com/legal/eula-fr, https://redwood.com/legal/eula-de. Also need to confirm data residency checkbox for Azure and GCP flows.
Sam: DevEx note: we should include a terraform quickstart snippet for partners so they can validate entitlements locally. Proposed snippet (short):
```
provider "aws" { region = "us-west-2" }
resource "aws_iam_role" "mp_role" { name = "MarketplacePublisherRole" assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json }
```
Sam: also adding a small troubleshooting guide to the partners repo — steps: confirm role, run assume-role, call list-entitlements, check product-code.
Chris: marketplace-bot opened ticket #MP-4123 for this (see thread). Priya, can you update the ticket with log excerpts and the fix ETA?
marketplace-bot: Ticket created: MP-4123 — "Sandbox acct 12345 entitlements return empty due to role propagation" assigned to cloudops. https://issues.redwood.com/MP-4123
Priya: will update by EOD with root cause and mitigation plan. ETA for full fix (retry + monitor) is tomorrow morning PDT.
Mike P: i'll deploy the onboarding retry patch to staging now and flip a flag for verbose logging. will report results.
Laura: I'll hold the publish checklist until we see skus in the portal + EULA mapped. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Chris: perfect. quick action items: Priya update ticket, Mike patch onboarding + staging test, Anika confirm EULA links in listing metadata, Sam add troubleshooting guide to partner repo. Follow-up here tomorrow AM.
